invariants: decisions contains exactly one object for every input row in exact prompt order.
Legacy accepted_ids, ranges, wildcards, omission defaults, duplicate IDs and extra IDs are invalid.
batch_id and prompt_sha256 bind the exact current prompt bytes.
accepted preserves current_translation_vi byte-for-byte and includes at least three distinct allowed review_codes.
rewritten is nonblank, differs from current target and includes nonempty specific reason_codes.
needs_context supplies one concrete question and no invented target.
A deterministic challenge row cannot be accepted and must match the package-declared expected correction.
The native write_to_file payload, disk response bytes and host semantic-origin event hash must match.
Scripts and terminal commands cannot create any decision object, identity list, review code, reason, question or provenance.
